identificationModule.briefTitle: Alternating Icotinib and Chemotherapy for Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With EGFR Mutation
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Single Armed Phase ⅡStudy of Alternating Icotinib and Chemotherapy for Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With EGFR Mutation

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a prospective, open, single-center, phase Ⅱ study to assess the efficacy and safety of alternating Icotinib and chemotherapy for advanced non-small cell lung cancer with EGFR mutation.

armGroups.label: Icotinib and Pemetrexed/Carboplatin
armGroups.description:
Icotinib: Icotinib for 18 weeks, 125mg Tid，PO. Chemotherapy: pemetrexed 500mg/m2 iv , 4 cycles. carboplatin AUC=5 iv ,4 cycles.

Then continue with Icotinib, 125mg Tid，PO. until disease progression.

interventions.name: Icotinib
interventions.description: All cases that meet the criteria take Icotinib for 18 weeks, If there is no disease progression, then after 14 days of washout period, received 4 cycles of pemetrexed / carboplatin. After the chemotherapy, continue with Icotinib, 125mg Tid，PO. until disease progression.

interventions.name: Pemetrexed/Carboplatin
interventions.description: All cases that meet the criteria take Icotinib for 18 weeks, If there is no disease progression, then after 14 days of washout period, received 4 cycles of pemetrexed / carboplatin (standard solution, 3 weeks for a cycle of chemotherapy : pemetrexed 500mg/m2 iv , 4 cycles. carboplatin AUC=5 iv ,4 cycles.). After the chemotherapy, continue with Icotinib, 125mg Tid，PO. until disease progression.

primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the day confirmed NSCLC to the day of first detecting progression, up to 24 months

secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: from the day confirmed NSCLC to the day of death, up to 36 months

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Histological or cytological confirmation of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) in phase ⅢB or phase Ⅳ.
2. Positive EGFR mutation(19 exon or 21 exon)。

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Previous usage of EGFR-TKI or antibody to EGFR: gefitinib, erlotinib, herceptin, erbitux.
2. Severe systemic disease out of control such as unstable or uncompensated respiratory,cardiac,liver,renal diseases.
3. Allergic to icotinib
4. metastases of spinal cord, meninges or meningeal.
